title: Operator Taste Choice
description: One line of `~/.chief-wiggum/portfolio/taste/choices.jsonl` (chief-wiggum#250) — an append-only, operator-private record of a chosen-not-converged pick from the #249 variant flow or `/design`. Lives in the private portfolio repo, NEVER the public chief-wiggum repo. Future variant generation reads the accumulated choices to CENTRE the spread on demonstrated preference; it must never COLLAPSE the spread — the divergence count (>=6 for outward assets per INV-LPS-006/INV-PRE-006, 3-4 for /design directions) stays fixed regardless of how narrow the operator's taste turns out to be.

context.description: What was being picked, free text (e.g. 'landing-page-smoke-test visual design', '/design direction', 'product name shortlist').

bet_id.description: The bet this pick belongs to, or null for a product-level (/design) pick.

design_taste_as_of.description: The docs/design-taste.md `as_of` date the variant generation was grounded against, so a stale-brief pick is visible in hindsight.

chosen.description: The picked direction/variant/candidate. `label` is the human-readable name; additional free-form tags describe its style (e.g. palette, typography move, register) for future centring.

rejected.description: Every rejected direction/variant/candidate, each with its own tags — the rejections are as informative as the pick for centring future spreads.

variant_count.description: Total variants presented (chosen + rejected) — recorded explicitly so a future centring pass can confirm the divergence count was never collapsed below the doctrine's floor for this context.
